basic_details.short_information: The District Mission Management Unit of the Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihood Mission (Tamil Nadu Maanila Oorga Vaazhvaadhaara Iyakkam), Theni District, invites applications for the post of District Resource Trainer (Maavatta Valappayitrunar) (Model Cluster Level Federation) (MCLF) on a purely temporary, honorarium basis. The honorarium is Rs.2000/- for A Grade and Rs.1500/- for B Grade per day of training, for a maximum of 15 days a month. how_to_apply: Applications must be handed in person, and the same office is the place where the selection will be held:
Prepare the application for the post of District Resource Trainer (Model Cluster Level Federation) (MCLF).
Hand it in at: Project Director / Joint Director, Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihood Mission, Integrated Office Complex, Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Ground Floor, Theni.
Make sure it reaches the office by 5.30 PM on 17 November 2026; applications received after that will not be accepted.
The notice does not give an application format or a list of documents to enclose. Office phone: 04546-255203.
important_instructions: For further details, contact the Mahalir Thittam office on working days only, before 6.00 PM. The post is purely temporary and paid only for days of training, up to 15 days a month.

content_sections.heading: About TNSRLM Theni
content_sections.text: The Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihood Mission works in Theni District through its District Mission Management Unit, and its office is at the Integrated Office Complex of the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department in Theni. The notice is issued as a notice-board announcement over the signature of the District Collector, Theni. The post serves the Model Cluster Level Federation (MCLF) work of the Mission, and further details are given out by the Mahalir Thittam office.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Any Post Graduate degree. Experience: 4 years of work experience in Self Help Groups / Federations, as a trainer, in the voluntary (NGO) sector and in other government department schemes implemented in rural areas. Age: Within 30-50 years as on 01.06.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Languages: Ability to read and write Tamil and English. Skills: Communication skill, coordination skill and interpersonal skill, and proficiency in handling mobile apps, Word and Excel. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The District Resource Trainer (MCLF) is paid an honorarium for each day of training: Rs.2000/- for A Grade and Rs.1500/- for B Grade. Work is limited to a maximum of 15 days a month. The notice describes the engagement as purely temporary work; it does not explain how the A Grade or B Grade is assigned.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNSRLM Theni Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be handed in person, and the same office is the place where the selection will be held: Prepare the application for the post of District Resource Trainer (Model Cluster Level Federation) (MCLF). Hand it in at: Project Director / Joint Director, Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihood Mission, Integrated Office Complex, Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Ground Floor, Theni. Make sure it reaches the office by 5.30 PM on 17 November 2026; applications received after that will not be accepted. The notice does not give an application format or a list of documents to enclose. Office phone: 04546-255203.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: For further details, contact the Mahalir Thittam office on working days only, before 6.00 PM. The post is purely temporary and paid only for days of training, up to 15 days a month.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for TNSRLM Theni District Resource Trainer applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be handed in by 5.30 PM on 17 November 2026. Applications received after that will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for the District Resource Trainer (MCLF) post?
faq.answer: Any Post Graduate degree, along with 4 years of work experience in Self Help Groups / Federations, as a trainer, in the NGO sector and in other government department schemes implemented in rural areas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for TNSRLM Theni Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be within 30-50 years of age as on 01.06.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for the District Resource Trainer post?
faq.answer: Rs.2000/- for A Grade and Rs.1500/- for B Grade per day of training, with work for a maximum of 15 days a month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for TNSRLM Theni Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Hand the application in person at the office of the Project Director / Joint Director, Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihood Mission, Integrated Office Complex, Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Ground Floor, Theni, by 5.30 PM on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is the TNSRLM Theni District Resource Trainer a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes it as purely temporary work on an honorarium basis, for a maximum of 15 days a month.

faq.question: Q7. Which languages and skills are needed?
faq.answer: Candidates must be able to read and write Tamil and English, have communication, coordination and interpersonal skills, and be proficient in mobile apps, Word and Excel.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I get more details about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Further details are available from the Mahalir Thittam office on working days only, before 6.00 PM; the office phone number is 04546-255203.
